desc: Implement per-vitamin 0/1 knapsack DPs indexed by calories, with descending calorie transitions.
Convert each DP from exact-cost reachability into maximum vitamin intake obtainable within each calorie budget via prefix maxima.
Enumerate calorie splits `(c1, c2, X-c1-c2)` and maximize `min(dp1[c1], dp2[c2], dp3[X-c1-c2])`.
Validate correctness and edge cases, including missing vitamin types and unused calorie capacity.
